test_title: PYST 29: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Aasish starts from point A and drives 62 km towards west. He then takes a right turn, drives 58 km, turns right and drives 64 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 78 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89457424a33de22a044ca94a736f7fe485d88a39f82cde878e52f42c944f3657.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6f370d021a3292909d6c4a0e7ed77c0b642122d29678bb266860e793d288c96.png] 

To reach point A again, he should drive **78 - 58 = 2**0 km toward North direction.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3”.
